messages:
Priya Menon: Quick heads-up  onsite candidate next Thu (Jul 14) needs an expedited schedule because theyre on tight childcare pickup at 11:30. Also asked for a caregiver-friendly waiting area and an iPad/tablet for the child. Can facilities/security/cafe arrange? :eyes:

Kelsey Ortiz: Thanks Priya. Candidate: Omar Ali, +1-415-555-0222. ETA 09:15 by BART. Wants the interview condensed to 75m max. Caregiver (named Samira) will stay on-site. Any scent/diet prefs?

Priya Menon: Omar prefers low-fragrance spaces. Vegetarian snack ok for both. Please reserve a small private alcove near Quiet Room G for caregiver with soft seating and kid-friendly toys. Need a short printed schedule to hand them.

Facilities Bot: Quiet Room G reserved (3rd floor) 09:0011:00. Adjacent Care Alcove held for caregiver with a pack-n-play, small table, and iPad (child friendly) charged and on guest wifi. Stroller route cleared. Low-scent cleaning applied.

Security Desk: Visitor badges printed for "Omar Ali" and "Samira (caregiver)". ID required at check-in. Escort to 3rd floor available. If Omar drives, P2 one-day permit ready. We'll SMS Priya at badge pickup.

Cafe Team: Vegetarian boxed snacks + two bottled waters ready at 09:10. Kid-friendly banana pouches provided. Low-fragrance packaging.

Volunteer Emma: I can meet them at lobby to escort and set up the Care Alcove. Happy to pick up the iPad from IT if needed.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: condensed interview template available. Use block schedule 3x20m + 1x15m wrap for 75m total.

Kelsey Ortiz: Run-of-day (compact):
```
09:15  Candidate arrival / badge check (Security)
09:25  Intro + systems check (10m)
09:35  Panel slot A (20m)
09:55  Panel slot B (20m)
10:15  Panel slot C (20m)
10:35  Wrap + quick Qs (15m)
10:50  Candidate leaves for pickup (11:00 latest)
```
Zoom fallback: https://zoom.redwood-inc/room-fallback

Priya Menon: Please confirm iPad guest profile (no social apps) and that Care Alcove has a soft blanket and white-noise machine. Security  text when badges printed. Emma  thanks for escort help. :pray:
